framework_lessons: Exact multi-entry ABI and toolchain preflight are prerequisites, not optimization evidence.
A golden evaluator-only implementation must validate distributed semantics before interpreting Agent failures.
Coherent logical fixtures and target-ownership-safe diagnostics are mandatory for TP correctness.
Distributed timing must fail closed on incomplete rank rows and must bind candidate, semantic evaluator, fixture, performance contract, baseline, and statistical policy.
Scope-equivalent benchmark eras and predeclared stability rules are required before promotion.
REAL profile evidence is required before generating another bounded Agent hypothesis.
candidate_lessons: Episodes 6 and 9 failed TARGET_LOGIT_WRONG: unshifted versus exponentiated target contribution.
Episode 7 remains the best stable forward incumbent; Episodes 11 and 12 are stable but lower-scoring.
performance_lessons: Episode 7 local kernels are no longer the dominant measured risk; single-rank collective delay and synchronization remain visible.
Slow valid samples are preserved and classified, not deleted.
